name: Cisco Secure Access
description: Cisco Secure Access API actions for Splunk SOAR

auth_header_name.description: HTTP header name for the Bearer token (value is always sent as 'Bearer {token}')

default_destination_list_id.description: Default destination list ID to use for automated domain/URL blocking

actions.description: Test OAuth authentication to Cisco Secure Access.
actions.verbose: Verifies that the configured asset can authenticate to Cisco Secure Access with OAuth credentials.

actions.description: List Cisco Secure Access destination lists.
actions.verbose: Lists destination list metadata. Set list_destinations to true to also fetch destination entries for each list. Use destination list IDs from this action when adding or removing destinations.

list_destinations.name: list_destinations
list_destinations.description: If true, also fetch and embed each list's destination entries. Default false (returns list metadata only).

actions.description: Create a Cisco Secure Access destination list.
actions.verbose: Creates a non-global destination list for Access policies. The request sets isGlobal=false and bundleTypeId=2. Optional destinations_json must be a JSON array of no more than 500 domain, URL, or IPv4 destinations. Cisco Secure Access does not support creating thirdparty_block destination lists through this API.

access.name: access
access.description: Access classification for the list (used with access rules). Cannot create lists with access type thirdparty_block via this API.

destinations_json.name: destinations_json
destinations_json.description: Optional JSON array of up to 500 destinations, e.g. [{"destination":"cisco.com","type":"domain","comment":"optional"}]. type: domain, url, or ipv4.

actions.description: Add one domain, URL, or IP destination to a destination list.
actions.verbose: Adds one destination entry per run. Provide a destination list ID from List Destination Lists, or configure a default destination list ID on the asset. The destination can be a domain, URL, or IP address.

destination_list_id.name: destination_list_id
destination_list_id.description: Destination List ID. If not provided, the default destination list ID will be used.

destination.name: destination
destination.description: Destination URL, domain, or IP address

actions.description: Remove one or more destination entries from a destination list.
actions.verbose: Removes destination entries by destination entry ID, not by destination value. Get entry IDs from List Destination Lists with list_destinations enabled or from Add To Destination List output. Provide a destination list ID or configure a default destination list ID on the asset.

destination_list_id.name: destination_list_id
destination_list_id.description: The ID of the Destination List to remove destinations from. If not provided, the default destination list ID will be used.

actions.description: List managed network devices registered in Cisco Secure Access.
actions.verbose: Lists Cisco Secure Access managed network devices. Use the originId returned by this action as the lookup or delete identifier for a device.

actions.description: Delete one managed network device by origin ID.
actions.verbose: Deletes a managed network device using its originId. Get the originId from List Managed Devices.

origin_id.name: origin_id
origin_id.description: Origin ID of the network device to remove (obtain from the List Managed Devices action).

actions.description: Get details for one managed network device by origin ID.
actions.verbose: Retrieves one managed network device using its originId. Get the originId from List Managed Devices.

origin_id.name: origin_id
origin_id.description: Origin ID of the network device (obtain from the List Managed Devices action).

actions.description: List virtual appliances in the organization
List sites in the organization
Get posture and security details for a roaming computer

device_id.name: device_id
device_id.description: The device ID (deviceId) of the roaming computer, e.g. AB00C7DCEC99D211.

actions.description: List roaming computers in the organization
List network tunnel groups in the organization

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Index to start reading the collection (0-based). Default 0.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Number of records per page (1-200). Default 10.

filters.name: filters
filters.description: Optional JSON object to filter by name, exactName, region, networkTunnelGroupIds, exactAuthIdPrefix, status, or duplicateCIDRs. See API docs.

sort_by.name: sort_by
sort_by.description: Sort field: name, status, createdAt, modifiedAt.

include_statuses.name: include_statuses
include_statuses.description: Include tunnelsStatus for each hub (max 10 tunnel states per hub).

actions.description: Get a network tunnel group by ID

id.name: id
id.description: ID of the network tunnel group (obtain from the List Network Tunnel Groups action).

actions.description: List resource connectors in the organization

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Index to start reading the collection (0-based). Default 0.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Default 10.

filters.name: filters
filters.description: Optional JSON object to filter by groupId, instanceId, status, confirmed, hasSynced, hasLatestVersion. See API docs.

sort_by.name: sort_by
sort_by.description: Sort field: instanceId, originIpAddress, createdAt, modifiedAt.

actions.description: Get the status and categorization of a domain

domain.name: domain
domain.description: Domain name to look up (e.g. cisco.com).

actions.description: Get the risk score for a domain

domain.name: domain
domain.description: Domain name to look up (e.g. cisco.com).

actions.description: Get passive DNS records for a domain

domain.name: domain
domain.description: The domain to get passive DNS records for.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Index to start reading the collection (0-based). Default 0.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum records to return in one call (1-9999). Default 1000. Use 9999 to retrieve the full set in a single call; the API caps total retrievable records at 10000 per domain.

actions.description: List device or security group tag identities
actions.verbose: Lists identities by type. Use type=device for device registrations or type=securityGroupTag for security group tag identities.

type.name: type
type.description: Identity type to list: 'device' for device registrations, 'securityGroupTag' for security group tags (SGTs).

actions.description: Create or update device or security group tag identities
actions.verbose: Creates or updates 1-250 identity objects from identities_json. Use type=device for device registrations and type=securityGroupTag for security group tag identities. Device objects use key, label, status, and authName. Security group tag objects use key, label, status, and tagId. Set status to inactive to deactivate an identity.

type.name: type
type.description: Identity type: 'device' for identity endpoints, 'securityGroupTag' for SGTs.

identities_json.name: identities_json
identities_json.description: JSON array of identity objects (1-250). Devices: {"key","label","status","authName"}. SGTs: {"key","label","status","tagId"}. status: "active"|"inactive".

actions.description: List latest ZTNA certificates for a specific user device.
actions.verbose: Lists the latest ACME-issued ZTNA certificates for one user device by user ID and device ID.

device_id.name: device_id
device_id.description: The ID of the user device.

actions.description: List latest ZTNA device certificates for a user.
actions.verbose: Lists the latest ACME-issued ZTNA device certificates for all devices associated with the specified user ID.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.description: The ID of the user (ZTNA). Get all device certificates for this user.

actions.description: Send an authenticated request to a Cisco Secure Access API endpoint.
actions.verbose: Sends an authenticated request using the asset's Cisco Secure Access OAuth credentials. Provide an API path relative to the configured base URL, such as deployments/v2/networkdevices. Do not include the base URL.

http_method.name: http_method
http_method.description: The HTTP method to use for the request.

endpoint.name: endpoint
endpoint.description: Cisco Secure Access API path, relative to the configured base URL. For example: 'deployments/v2/networkdevices' or 'admin/v2/vpn/userConnections'. Do not include the base URL.

headers.name: headers
headers.description: The headers to send with the request (JSON object). An example is {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}

query_parameters.name: query_parameters
query_parameters.description: Parameters to append to the URL (JSON object or query string). An example is ?key=value&key2=value2

body.name: body
body.description: The body to send with the request (JSON object). An example is {'key': 'value', 'key2': 'value2'}

timeout.name: timeout
timeout.description: The timeout for the request in seconds.

verify_ssl.name: verify_ssl
verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify the SSL certificate. Default true.

actions.description: Create an access policy rule.
actions.verbose: Creates an access policy rule. rule_conditions_json and rule_settings_json are required JSON arrays. rule_name must be unique and 2-50 characters.

rule_name.name: rule_name
rule_name.description: Rule name (2-50 alphanumeric, hyphen, underscore, space). Unique across access rules.

rule_priority.name: rule_priority
rule_priority.description: Optional priority (positive integer, unique across rules).

rule_is_enabled.name: rule_is_enabled
rule_is_enabled.description: Whether the rule is enabled. Default true.

actions.description: List access policy rules.
actions.verbose: Lists access policy rules. Use rule_name or filters to narrow results when needed.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Index to start reading the collection (0-based). Default 0.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Number of rules per page. Max 1000. Default 10.

rule_name.name: rule_name
rule_name.description: Filter by rule name or substring (e.g. 'Allow all rule').

filters.name: filters
filters.description: Optional JSON object to filter rules by properties (ruleName, ruleDescription, ruleIsEnabled, ruleAction, ruleConditions, sources, destinations, etc.). Cannot combine ruleConditions with sources/destinations.

actions.description: List Cisco Secure Web Gateway override settings for managed devices.
actions.verbose: Lists Cisco Secure Web Gateway override settings for 1-100 device origin IDs. Use origin IDs from managed or roaming device inventory.

origin_ids.name: origin_ids
origin_ids.description: Comma-separated origin IDs of devices (1-100) to list SWG override settings for.

actions.description: Set Cisco Secure Web Gateway override settings for managed devices.
actions.verbose: Sets Cisco Secure Web Gateway override settings for 1-100 device origin IDs. Use value 1 to enable Secure Web Gateway and value 0 to disable it for the specified devices.

value.name: value
value.description: Enable (1) or disable (0) Secure Web Gateway for the devices.

origin_ids.name: origin_ids
origin_ids.description: Comma-separated origin IDs of devices (1-100). Devices must be registered as roaming computers.

actions.description: Delete Cisco Secure Web Gateway override settings for managed devices.
actions.verbose: Deletes Cisco Secure Web Gateway override settings for 1-100 device origin IDs. After removal, the organization Secure Web Gateway setting applies.

origin_ids.name: origin_ids
origin_ids.description: Comma-separated origin IDs of devices (1-100) to remove SWG override setting from. Organization SWG setting will apply after removal.
